name: UGC NET
intro: UGC NET now captures your photograph live during the application. Your signature is uploaded as a scanned file.

notes: The form captures a live photo through your webcam, or through your phone using a QR code.
White background, good light, and at least 80% of your face visible including your ears.
documents.label: Photograph

source.label: Summary of UGC NET December 2026 application rules (news summary, check the information bulletin)

faqs.q: Is the UGC NET photo uploaded or live?
faqs.a: Live. The application captures your photo through the camera. Only the signature is uploaded as a file, between 10 KB and 50 KB.
